sap-docs-community.description: Remote HTTP/SSE: Semantic vector and full-text search across SAP Community blogs, official documentation, ABAP keyword reference, UI5, and DSAG guidelines (Remote URL, no local process required).

sap-developers-search.description: Remote HTTP/SSE: Official SAP Developer Center MCP service providing step-by-step developer tutorials and learning missions (Remote URL).

sap-notes.description: Hosted stdio: Search official SAP Support Notes and Knowledge Base Articles (KBAs) on me.sap.com via npx.

sap-help-portal-local.description: Local Python implementation: Stdio MCP server for SAP Help Portal search and APIM policies (SpikeArrest, Quota, VerifyAPIKey, RaiseFault).

sap-api-hub-local.description: Local Python implementation: Stdio MCP server for SAP Business Accelerator Hub (OData v2/v4, REST, and CloudEvents).
